factor.title: Sign-in with a code
factor.description: More protection for your account: after your password you enter a code. moto sends the code to your email address.
factor.switchOnTooltip: Sends a code to your email address.
factor.switchOffTooltip: Asks for your password for safety.
factor.sentTo: We sent a code to {email}. Enter the 6 digits.
factor.confirmTooltip: Turns on sign-in with a code for your account.
factor.resendTooltip: Sends a new code. The old one no longer works.
factor.disableIntro: After that, your password is enough to sign in again. Enter your password for safety.
factor.disableTooltip: Turns off sign-in with a code right away.
factor.enabledToast: Sign-in with a code is on.
factor.disabledToast: Sign-in with a code is off.
factor.renewFailed: Sign-in with a code is on. Please sign in again once.
factor.reauthenticateTooltip: Signs you out. Then you sign in with a code.
factor.unavailable: You can turn on sign-in with a code as soon as your account belongs to a school.
factor.confirmObject: turning on sign-in with a code
factor.disableObject: turning off sign-in with a code
factor.stepPassword: You sign in with your password as usual.
factor.stepCode: moto sends you a code by email. You enter it.
factor.stepRemember: On your own device, choose “Yes, remember”. moto then does not ask for a code there for a while.
factor.accountNote: Applies to your whole moto account.
factor.recoveryNote: No longer have access to your mailbox? Contact your school. The moto team will then reset sign-in with a code.

devices.title: Remembered devices
devices.description: On these devices moto does not ask for a code. Remove devices you no longer use.
devices.emptyDescription: After the code at sign-in you can choose “Yes, remember and sign in”.
devices.removeDescription: moto asks first. After that the device asks for the code again.
devices.confirmText: {device} will be removed. At the next sign-in there, moto asks for the code again.

challenge.title: Enter code
challenge.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
challenge.autoCheck: As soon as all 6 digits are there, moto checks the code.
challenge.question: Should moto remember this device?
challenge.rememberHint: No code on this device for {days} days. Only for your own device.
challenge.onceHint: For devices that several people use.
challenge.removeDevicesHint: You can remove remembered devices under “Settings → Sign-in”.
